title: Weather Shower (Updated)
description: A client-side HUD mod that displays current weather/time with icons. Originally by Velmir-F, now ported to 1.21.11 & 1.21.1 with configurable HUD position, icon size, and more via Cloth Config. Supports Fabric and NeoForge.
body:
## Weather Shower ☀️🌙

Originally created by **[Velmir-F](https://github.com/Velmir-F/Weather_Shower)** ([original Modrinth page](https://modrinth.com/mod/weather-shower)).  
This is a community-maintained port to **Minecraft 1.21.11 & 1.21.1** with added configuration support.

A lightweight and stylish client-side mod that displays the current time of day or weather using both **text and a matching icon**. Whether it's sunrise, daylight, sunset, night, rain, or thunder — you'll always know what's happening around you!

---

### 🛠 Features

- **Shows the time of day:** 🌅 Morning, ☀️ Day, 🌇 Evening, 🌙 Night
- **Displays current weather:** 🌧️ Rain, ⛈️ Thunder
- **Icon + text overlay** for clarity and immersion
- **Sleep indicator** — shows when you can sleep (night or thunderstorms)
- **Fully configurable HUD** via Cloth Config + ModMenu:
  - Position (X/Y offset from screen edges)
  - Icon size
  - Update interval
  - Toggle sleep icon
- Works in any biome and dimension
- Simple and clean UI integration

---

### ⚙️ Configuration

Open **Esc → Mods → Weather Shower → Config** (requires [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) for Fabric, or [ModMenu (NeoForge Edition)](https://modrinth.com/mod/mod-menu-(neoforge-edition)) for NeoForge) to customize everything in-game. No manual file editing required.

Powered by **Cloth Config**.

---

### 🌍 Supported Languages

- 🇩🇪 German (Deutsch)
- 🇫🇷 French (Français)
- 🇪🇸 Spanish (Español)
- 🇬🇧 English
- 🇺🇦 Ukrainian
- 🇯🇵 Japanese (日本語)
- 🇵🇱 Polish (Polski)
- 🇨🇳 Chinese (中文)

---

### 📋 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.11 or 1.21.1
- **Mod Loader:** [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.19.3+ or [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/) 21.1.77+
- **Dependencies:** [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (Fabric only), [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- **Optional:** [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (Fabric) or [ModMenu (NeoForge Edition)](https://modrinth.com/mod/mod-menu-(neoforge-edition)) (NeoForge) — for in-game settings GUI
